name: Fireblocks
description: Fireblocks is an institutional-grade MPC custody, digital asset wallet, and network settlement platform that acts as a secure cryptographic signing and transaction orchestration layer. It utilizes multi-party computation (MPC-CMP) to eliminate single points of failure for private keys while enforcing institutional security policies across multi-rail on-chain networks, centralized exchanges, and banking rails.
capabilities: Treasury, liquidity, and omnibus account management
